newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Benefun Int'l debuts at HK$1.80/shr.
newsitem.headline: Benefun Int'l debuts at HK$1.80/shr.

text.p: Shares of casual wear retailer Benefun International Holdings Ltd made their trading debut on the Hong Kong stock market at HK$1.80 per share compared with their issue price of HK$1.15 each.
Benefun, a unit of Singapore-listed Heshe Holdings Ltd, is engaged in retailing and manufacture of casual wear in China, Hong Kong and Taiwan.
The company issued 100 million new shares in a public offering in Hong Kong. Its Hong Kong IPO was 105 times oversubscribed.
The company had said proceeds would be used to further develop its retail network, expand production facilities in China and reduce the group's short-term bank loans.
